notes: The open-loops ledger — the spine of the Call -> Choice->Consequence pipeline. One row per story thread the audience can follow: an observable situation with a genuinely undecided outcome. A Call post (the-call.md) OPENS the loop socially; the feed resolves it; a follow-up post (TF-*) CLOSES it; a verified pair makes it eligible for a Choice -> Consequence clip (choice-and-consequence.md). LOCAL ONLY: this file is an audit trail, never a queue — nothing here posts itself. Populate from the public feed once live; until launch it stays empty on purpose.

field_spec.id: t<N> — stable, never reused, even after resolution
field_spec.title: one-line human description ('Dani's extra shift cover')
residents: cast ids (c1..c8, s1..s3, a*) — first named = POV
field_spec.tone: kindness | competence | conflict | humor | mixed — used for the C->C ratio rule (>=1 kind/competent/funny per conflict pair)
field_spec.thread_url: feed permalink — REQUIRED before any post cites the thread; no permalink = no post (the permalink IS the 'that's scripted' rebuttal)

call.draft: TC1-TC5 id from the-call.md, or null
call.posted: bool — a Call must be registered BEFORE posting
call.post_url: URL of the posted Call, or null
call.deadline: YYYY-MM-DD or null — null means 'no deadline' wording was used; polls cap at 48h

tally.yes_pct: 0-100 int, or null until poll closes

call.audience_right: true | false | null — filled at resolution; feeds the scoreboard ('the audience is X-Y against the block')

resolution.evidence_url: feed permalink of the resolving event — REQUIRED when status=resolved
resolution.followup_posted: bool — false on a resolved called thread is a BROKEN PROMISE (thread_check FAILs)

cc_pair.draft: CC1-CC6 id from choice-and-consequence.md, or null
cc_pair.posted: bool — may ONLY be true when status=resolved (consequence must exist)

status_vocab.open: outcome genuinely undecided — Calls and follow-writes live here
status_vocab.resolved: the feed stamped an outcome; evidence_url required
status_vocab.stale: open > 14 days with no movement — revisit weekly or retire with honesty wording
status_vocab.closed-quiet: the thread ended without a legible outcome — no post, but keep the row (history is useful)

rules: every Call post registers here before it goes out — an unregistered Call is unauditable
every resolved called thread owes a follow-up post (win, loss, AND wild variants pre-drafted in the-call.md)
a thread with no consequence yet is a Call candidate, never a C->C post
viewer-request-caused threads are allowed and better — source=request:rq-<id> makes the attribution explicit
rows are append-only; retire via status, never delete
